verdict.rationale: MoQ Relay is a real-time media relay, and products of that kind can plausibly ship SIP or telephony bridging, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions SIP, trunking, PSTN or telephony carriers. The documented ingest and egress options are ffmpeg, OBS, GStreamer, HLS, CMAF and WebRTC players, none of which is SIP interoperability.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the service documents SIP interoperability with my existing trunking or telephony provider rather than locking me to one carrier
